name: paper-to-quiz
description: Convert PDF exams and worksheets into secure, image-based WordPress quizzes.

scripts.test:php: wp-env run cli composer --working-dir=wp-content/plugins/paper-to-quiz install --quiet && wp-env run cli composer --working-dir=wp-content/plugins/paper-to-quiz test
scripts.i18n: wp-env run cli sh -c "cd wp-content/plugins/paper-to-quiz && php -d memory_limit=512M /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-pot . languages/paper-to-quiz.pot --exclude=node_modules,tests,languages,build/pdf.worker.min.js --allow-root"
scripts.env:install: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const path = require('node:path'); const wpEnv = process.platform === 'win32' ? path.resolve('node_modules/.bin/wp-env.cmd') : 'wp-env'; const options = process.platform === 'win32' ? { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true } : { stdio: 'inherit' }; const run = (args) => { const result = spawnSync(wpEnv, args, options); if (result.status !== 0) process.exit(result.status || 1); }; const installed = spawnSync(wpEnv, ['run', 'cli', 'wp', 'core', 'is-installed'], options); if (installed.status !== 0) run(['run', 'cli', 'wp', 'core', 'install', '--url=http://localhost:8888', '--title=Paper to Quiz Integration', '--admin_user=admin', '--admin_password=paper-to-quiz-integration', '--admin_email=admin@example.com', '--skip-email']); run(['run', 'cli', 'wp', 'plugin', 'activate', 'paper-to-quiz']);"
scripts.test:integration:run: wp-env run cli env WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE=local PAPER_TO_QUIZ_ALLOW_REGRESSION=1 wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/paper-to-quiz/tests/data-regression.php && wp-env run cli env WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE=local PAPER_TO_QUIZ_ALLOW_REGRESSION=1 wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/paper-to-quiz/tests/rest-regression.php
